run_starlette_app: run the starlette app that serves an allennlp question answering inference endpoint
build_pipeline_getter: build a cached pipeline getter function that loads a model from environment variables
create_allowed_tasks_dict: create a dictionary mapping task names to pipeline classes for supported inference tasks
configure_cors_middleware: configure cors middleware on the starlette app when debug mode is enabled
setup_startup_event: setup an async startup event that initializes logging and loads the inference pipeline
